icy.looks: Blue-white or black-and-white, thin and hard-edged, with little glow.
icy.sounds: High, clear, sparse sound: harmonics, glassy upper strings, a flute or a high piano alone.

cool.looks: Blues, violets and greys; colour held back.
cool.sounds: Calm, detached music, or harmony far from home (modal, chromatic colour).

warm.looks: Reds, ochres, ambers and cream in soft light.
warm.sounds: Home-key harmony in the middle register, rich vibrato, legato.

burning.looks: Ember to white-hot: things heat up as they move or get hit.

heavy.looks: Big dark masses that land and sink.
heavy.sounds: Low register, loud bass, slow hard attacks: tolls, octaves, tutti chords.

airy.looks: Small, sparse shapes with a lot of space around them.
airy.sounds: High, soft, thin textures; a few notes at a time.

grainy.sounds: Many short notes: repeated notes, tremolo, staccato, broken chords.

silky.looks: Smooth unbroken lines and soft gradients.
silky.sounds: Legato, sustained, bowed or sung lines.

brittle.looks: Sharp, thin marks that crack, snap, scratch or erode.
brittle.sounds: Dry, short, hard attacks: staccato, pizzicato, harpsichord, accented dissonance.

liquid.looks: Ink, dye, melt: colour that spreads, bleeds and drips.
liquid.sounds: Washes of sound: pedal, resonance, blended harmony.

fibrous.looks: Hair, thread, filament: many fine strands, like the hairs on an arm.
fibrous.sounds: Bowed or plucked strings, many voices close together.

rough.looks: Coarse, dry-brushed, torn edges: nothing smooth, the bristles show.
rough.sounds: Harsh, rasping attack: heavy bowing, brass forte, accents dug in.

smeared.looks: Paint dragged and wiped across: streaks that trail behind the stroke.
smeared.sounds: Attacks that drag: slurred chords, glissandi, a blur of pedal.

tentacled.looks: Thick arms that reach, curl and grab out from a dark centre.
tentacled.sounds: Low lines that reach upward: rising bass figures, low chords that swell and spread.

still.looks: Almost nothing moves; change is a slow fade.

flowing.looks: Continuous drift: currents, scrolling, a line that never stops.
flowing.sounds: Steady legato motion, running figures without hard accents.

swelling.looks: Shapes that grow, breathe and glow up, then fall back.
swelling.sounds: Crescendo, held notes that bloom, a phrase that swells and lets go.

marching.looks: Regular steps: hops, rows, a grid, things that scroll on a beat.
marching.sounds: A clear pulse: dance rhythm, repeated patterns, counterpoint ticking along.

skittish.looks: Small things that twitch, freeze and bolt.

stabbing.looks: Sudden cuts, slashes, strikes and flashes.

twitchy.looks: Answers every attack at once with a quick, sharp jolt, then snaps back.
twitchy.sounds: Fast, articulate, detached playing; quick attacks.

unison.looks: Many things moving as one: a flock or a shoal turning together, every dot in step.
unison.sounds: One line everyone follows: a melody in unison or octaves, a single voice.

dark.looks: A black or deep ground, low light.
dark.sounds: Low register, minor mode, menace (loud or soft).

vivid.looks: Saturated flat colours with strong contrast.
vivid.sounds: Bright orchestration, clear rhythm, major-mode energy.

glowing.looks: Light from inside: halos, bloom, embers.
glowing.sounds: Sustained resonance: held tones, warm vibrato, a ringing chord.

longing.looks: One line reaching across space, fading trails.
longing.sounds: An expressive melody: suspensions, rubato, a solo that sings.

triumphant.looks: Big, bright, confident forms that rise.
triumphant.sounds: Loud major tutti, brass fanfares, final cadences.

dread.sounds: Low, slow, ominous: tolling bass, minor chords.

anxious.looks: Restless, never settling: small tremors, things that flinch and fidget.
anxious.sounds: Nervous agitation below a climax: tremolo, fast repeated notes, unresolved harmony.

violent.looks: Strikes that land like blows: sudden, huge, merciless.
violent.sounds: Brutal accents, sforzando hammering, off-beat stabs (the Rite).

mysterious.looks: Half-seen shapes you cannot quite make out; something forming and dissolving.
mysterious.sounds: Hushed and unresolved: soft, modal or chromatic, a question left open.

alien.looks: Uncanny, not of this world: things that grow, reach and writhe in a way nothing alive should.
alien.sounds: Low, strange harmony: clusters, tritones, growling bass, dark brass.

piano.label: Piano
piano.sound: Hammer attack, then decay; the pedal blurs.

harpsichord.label: Harpsichord
harpsichord.sound: Plucked, no sustain, bright and mechanical; counterpoint.

plucked.label: Guitar / harp / lute / pizzicato
plucked.sound: A pluck and a ring: dots, arpeggios, an old guitar.

violin.label: Violin
violin.sound: The singing top line; also the nervous one (spiccato, tremolo).

viola.label: Viola
viola.sound: The veiled inner voice; dark, a little husky.

cello.label: Cello
cello.sound: A warm low voice with a long bow; a phrase that swells.

contrabass.label: Contrabass
contrabass.sound: The floor: low pedal, pizzicato bass, menace.

strings.label: Strings (section)
strings.sound: The massed bowed sound: pads, tremolo, swells, flocks of lines.

flute.label: Flute
flute.sound: Airy and light; runs and birdlike lines.

oboe.label: Oboe
oboe.sound: A thin, plaintive, slightly nasal solo.

clarinet.label: Clarinet
clarinet.sound: Round and supple, from a breathy whisper to a jazzy swoop.

bassoon.label: Bassoon
bassoon.sound: Dark and reedy at the bottom, comic when staccato.

horn.label: Horn
horn.sound: Round, warm, distant; long held calls.

trumpet.label: Trumpet
trumpet.sound: Bright, fanfare, a yellow point of light.

trombone.label: Trombone
trombone.sound: Heavy blocks of sound, slides and smears.

voice.label: Voice / choir
voice.sound: A sung line, or a choir's sustained chords.

tutti.label: Tutti / full orchestra
tutti.sound: Everybody at once: loud, full, wide.
